hostHint: The CLI and credentials stay on the NomiFun backend computer, which may differ from this browser.

connection.secretHint: Used once by the backend CLI. This page does not store the secret.

runtime.title: Feishu CLI
runtime.advanced: Environment details and other installation options
runtime.notBundled: The CLI is downloaded only after you choose to install it. It is not bundled with NomiFun. Existing official installations are reused.
runtime.brokenHint: A broken installation is not a missing one. Repair installs the official component in the managed location without touching the existing installation, or select another program below.
runtime.checkOnly: Checking does not install or upgrade. External installations remain managed by their original tools.
runtime.fullWizardHint: The official full setup command may also install global Agent Skills and enter application configuration. Run it explicitly in your own terminal.

permissions.readMissing: Reading permission is required. This does not mean the account has no data.

groupHints.documents: List and search documents and Wiki resources available to this account. Open content in your browser.

auth.title: Feishu permission
auth.returnHint: Return to your input and save again. Authorization never submits a business operation.
auth.waitingHint: Complete the steps on the official Feishu page. NomiFun observes the same authorization flow.
auth.adminHint: Your enterprise administrator needs to approve the application or permission.
auth.cancellingHint: Cancellation was accepted. The original CLI is still cleaning up; keep observing before starting another authorization.

resources.name: Name
resources.browserHint: Document content opens in your browser.
resources.listHint: Documents available to this account through search, including Drive and Wiki, ordered by update time.
resources.invalidLink: Use a complete official Feishu or Lark HTTPS document link.
resources.missingLink: No link is available. Search for the document or paste its complete link.
resources.paginationError: Invalid pagination information. Refresh and try again.

documents.title: Document title
documents.createHint: Create a blank document, then open it in your browser to write content.
documents.deleteHint: Delete this cloud document? It will be moved to the Feishu recycle bin.

operation.identityChanged: Switch to the original application and user before verifying this operation.
operation.identityChangedInput: The application or user changed. Reopen the form before submitting.
operation.networkHint: The request may still be running. Read the original receipt; do not submit again.
operation.notExecutedHint: No write was sent. Correct the input if needed, then save again.
operation.pendingHint: The original operation is being observed. It will not be sent again.
operation.unknownHint: The write may have happened. Verification reads the original target or receipt and never resends it.
operation.baseHint: The batch was accepted. Each original record still needs to be read back.
operation.readbackConfirmed: The requested field values were observed at the original record.

account.accountHint: See who is signed in, or switch to another Feishu account.
account.privateHint: Credentials stay with the official Feishu component
account.partialHint: Some permissions were not granted. You can authorize them when needed.
account.logoutHint: Sign out {{name}} from this connection. Documents and other content in Feishu will remain unchanged.
account.switchHint: Keep the application configuration and choose another account on the official Feishu page.
account.signedOutHint: Reading stops after sign-out. You can sign in again whenever you need.
account.installFirst: Install the connection component before signing in.
account.loginTitle: Sign in to your Feishu account
account.loginHint: Confirm your identity on the official Feishu page. Sign-in opens Documents; content access is requested separately.
account.disabledHint: Enable the connection to sign in and read content. Disabling does not sign you out.
account.newAppHint: First, link an enterprise application. Set it up on the official Feishu page, or use details provided by your administrator.
account.manualApp: Have an application ID and secret?
account.accessHint: Enable only the reading permissions you need. You do not have to select everything during sign-in.
account.loginFirst: Sign in to see and manage your access permissions.
account.writeAccessHint: Creating, deleting or updating content asks for write permission during that action.
account.componentHint: The component communicates with Feishu. A compatible existing installation is reused.
account.installingHint: Preparing the component. You can sign in when it is ready.
account.disableHint: Disabling stops new reads and writes. It does not sign you out or revoke Feishu authorization.

connectScreen.missingHint: A one-time setup. Then sign in with your Feishu account to access documents and Base tables.
connectScreen.installingHint: Sign-in will be available when preparation finishes. You do not need to install again or keep a dialog open.
connectScreen.repairHint: The detected component is not ready. Repair it as a managed official component (the existing installation is untouched), or select another program in connection settings.
connectScreen.disabledHint: No Feishu content is being read or written. Enable the connection to continue with your account or sign in again.
connectScreen.expiredHint: Your login has expired. Confirm your identity to continue with your documents and Base tables.
connectScreen.loginHint: Handle documents and Base tables in one place. Use your own account and grant access only when needed.
connectScreen.componentHint: Connect through the official component. Existing installations can be reused.
connectScreen.componentReady: The component is ready for sign-in.
connectScreen.accountHint: Confirm your identity on the official page. No account password is entered here.
connectScreen.privacy: Only authorized content is accessed. Switch accounts or sign out at any time.
